verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच। इमे वै मानवा लोके स्त्रीषु सज्जन्त्यभीक्ष्णशः । मोहेन परमाविष्टा देवसृष्टेन पार्थिव ॥१॥
verses.english: Yudhishthira said Overcome by the illusion of the divine Being, all men, O king in this world, are seen to attach themselves to women.

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रियश्च पुरुषेष्वेव प्रत्यक्षं लोकसाक्षिकम् । अत्र मे संशयस्तीव्रो हृदि संपरिवर्तते ॥२॥
verses.english: Likewise, women, too, are seen to attach themselves to men. All this is seen taking place everywhere in the world. I have a doubt on this subject.

verses.sanskrit: कथमासां नराः सङ्गं कुर्वते कुरुनन्दन । स्त्रियो वा केषु रज्यन्ते विरज्यन्ते च ताःपुनः ॥३॥
verses.english: Why, O delighter of the Kurus, do men still attach themselves to women? Who, again, are those men with whom are women highly pleased, and who are they with whom they are displeased.

verses.sanskrit: इति ताः पुरुषव्याघ्र कथं शक्यास्तु रक्षितुम् । प्रमदाः पुरुषेणेह तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हसि ॥४॥
verses.english: You should, O chief of men, explain to me how men are capable of protecting women?

verses.sanskrit: एता हि रममाणास्तु वञ्चयन्तीह मानवान् । न चासां मुच्यते कश्चित्पुरुषो हस्तमागतः ॥५॥
verses.english: While men take pleasure in women and sport with them, women, it seems, are engaged in imposing upon men. Then, again, if a man once falls into their hands, it is difficult for him to escape from them. Like kine ever liking pastures new, women like new men one after another.

verses.sanskrit: गावो नवतृणानीव गृह्णन्त्येता नवं नवम् । शंबरस्य च या माया माया या नमुचेरपि ॥६॥
verses.english: The women have in them the sum total of that illusion which the Asura Shambara possessed, that illusion which the Asura Namuchi possessed, that illusion which Bali or Kumbhinasi had.

verses.sanskrit: बलेः कुम्भीनसेश्चैव सर्वास्ता योषितो विदुः । हसन्तं प्रहसन्त्येता रुदन्तं प्ररुदन्ति च ॥७॥
verses.english: If man laughs, women laugh. If man weeps, they weep. If the opportunity requires, they receive the man who is disagreeable to them with sweet words.

verses.sanskrit: अप्रियं प्रियवाक्यैश्च गृह्णते कालयोगतः । उशना वेद यच्छास्रं यच्च वेद बृहस्पतिः ॥८॥
verses.english: That science of policy which the preceptor of the Asuras knew, that science of policy which the preceptor of the celestials, viz., Brihaspati, knew, is not deeper or more subtile than what woman's intelligence. Indeed, how can women, therefore, be restrained by men?

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीबुद्ध्या न विशिष्येत तास्तु रक्ष्याः कथं नरैः । अनृतं सत्यमित्याहुः सत्यं चापि तथानृतम् ॥९॥
verses.english: They make a lie appear as truth, and a truth, appear as a lie. They who can do this I ask, O hero how can they be governed by persons of the opposite sex?

verses.sanskrit: इति यास्ताः कथं वीर संरक्ष्याः पुरुषैरिह । स्त्रीणां बुद्ध्यर्थनिष्कर्षादर्थशास्त्राणि शत्रुहन् ॥१०॥
verses.english: It appears to me that Brihaspati and othur great thinkers, O destroyer of enemies evolved the science of policy from observation of the understanding of women.

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिप्रभृतिभिर्मन्ये सद्भिः कृतानि वै । संपूज्यमानाः पुरुषैर्विकुर्वन्ति मनो नृषु ॥११॥
verses.english: Whether treated by men, with respect or with hatred, women are seen to turn the heads and agitate the hearts of men.

verses.sanskrit: अपास्ताश्च तथा राजन् ‌विकुर्वन्ति मनः स्त्रियः । इमाः प्रजा महाबाहो धार्मिक्य इति नः श्रुतम् ॥१२॥
verses.english: Living creatures, O you of mighty arms are virtuous. Even this is what we have heard. Treated with love and respect or otherwise women are seen to deserve censure for their conduct towards men.

verses.sanskrit: सत्कृतासत्कृताश्चापि विकुर्वन्ति मनः सदा । कस्ताः शक्तो रक्षितुं स्यादिति मे संशयो महान् ॥१३॥
verses.english: This great doubt fills my mind, viz., when their conduct is such, what man is there that can restrain them within the limits of virtue? Do you explain this to me, O highly blessed scion of Kuru's race.

verses.sanskrit: तथा ब्रूहि महाभाग कुरूणां वंशवर्धन । यदि शक्या कुरुश्रेष्ठ रक्षा तासां कदाचन । कर्तुं वा कृतपूर्वं वा तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हसि ॥१४॥
verses.english: You should tell me, O chief of Kuru's race, whether women are truly capable of being governed within the limits prescribed by the scriptures or whether any one before our time did really succeeded in so controlling them.
